article_content: Coronation Street star Barbara Knox has been arrested on suspicion of drink driving in Cheshire. The 80-year-old, who plays Rita Tanner in the soap, was taken into custody after allegedly driving to a police station to remonstrate with officers following the arrest of her daughter Maxine Ashcroft for the same offense. According to reports, Knox's daughter was stopped by police while driving her mother home from an outing in Cheshire. Ashcroft was found to be almost three times over the legal limit for alcohol consumption. Knox then drove to the police station, where she was also arrested. A Cheshire Police spokesman confirmed the incident, stating that a 56-year-old woman from Gloucestershire was arrested on suspicion of drink driving, and an 80-year-old woman from Knutsford was also arrested on suspicion of drink driving after arriving at the police station.

article_content: Mexico City, Mexico (CNN) - Shootouts between drug suspects and the military in the northeastern border state of Tamaulipas have resulted in seven deaths and 11 injuries, according to government reports. The incidents occurred in the cities of Miguel Aleman, Mier, and Valadeces, which are located near the US border and the city of Reynosa, where the US consulate was closed due to increased drug violence. The Mexican military was ambushed while on patrol late Thursday night, resulting in the death of one soldier and injuring 11 others. The US Consulate issued a warning to US citizens about recent gun battles in Reynosa and surrounding cities. The violence is part of a larger conflict between drug cartels and the government, which has resulted in over 16,000 deaths since 2006.
